Palestine Action activists accused of factory raid and smashing vehicle

Palestine Action activists are accused of raiding a factory and smashing a Land Rover vehicle that was reportedly blocking their entry. Video footage of the incident was presented in court. The group allegedly broke into the factory, and in the process, damaged a Land Rover that was obstructing their access.
